evidence.reason: At the current tip the dependency regex still enumerates only the listed directives and omits systemd v257 stop-propagation directives `StopPropagatedFrom=` and `PropagatesStopTo=`. The scanner therefore cannot discover a co-installed unit such as `ingress.service` with `StopPropagatedFrom=crq-tick.service`, so fencing `crq-tick.service` can also stop the co-tenant. This is a concrete gap in the existing dependency-scan behavior, not a new requirement.
